question: Does one fixed effective variance family, using the exact Kodak 250D characteristic-curve slope and the exact P5J positive-PSF channel attenuation under the sheet's 48-micrometre aperture, predict disjoint Kodak 250D diffuse-rms granularity points better than simpler and mismatched controls?

fit_parameters: one nonnegative variance floor per channel

spatial_energy_grid.channel_energy_normalization: divide by geometric mean across blue, green and red

model.curve_derivative: right_interval slope of the frozen piecewise-linear P2Q curve, clamped only at the first and last observed knot

split.eligibility: finite P4AV points inside the same channel's inclusive P2Q characteristic exposure domain
split.ordering: ascending log10 exposure independently within each channel
split.development: eligible sorted index modulo 3 is 0 or 2

controls.channel_constant: one nonnegative development variance mean per channel
controls.density_only: nonnegative channel floors plus one shared nonnegative amplitude times density above the channel minimum
controls.characteristic_slope_without_p5j: the selected family with every channel energy fixed to one
controls.wrong_channel_p5j: the selected family with the frozen cyclic channel-energy permutation

metrics.point_error: absolute natural-log ratio of predicted sigma_d to observed sigma_d
metrics.control_improvement: (control confirmation median point error - selected confirmation median point error) / control confirmation median point error
metrics.shape_rank: Spearman correlation between predicted and observed sigma_d per channel on confirmation rows

branch_rule.pass: Retain one effective same-sheet characteristic-slope/aperture/MTF compatibility family for a separately frozen synthetic compiler challenge; do not infer causal dye-cloud scale or stock calibration.
branch_rule.fail: Close this exact joint family without changing floors, split, spatial-energy computation, controls or gates. Preserve whichever simpler control wins and move to a materially different physical observation.

forbidden: change the trace, split, derivative, PSF mapping, aperture model, fit family or gates after scoring
treat same-sheet publication as same-roll or same-equipment paired calibration
infer a causal emulsion, dye-cloud, process, scanner or stock-response parameter
render photographs, promote a profile or alter the product renderer
claim_ceiling: Compatibility test among first-party Kodak 250D typical graph observations under one stated ECN-2/Status-M context, using an effective bounded variance family; not causal mechanism identification, full NPS, roll/process/scanner calibration, stock response or product evidence.
